Section: Sales Rep Hub > Customer profile > Available coupons
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]

Seeded by `npm run seed:promotions:sales-rep-coupons` (SRCPN_* aliases; rolling dates and a recorded-use count, so every assertion is a relation between values the case reads, never a literal date or count).

D = (11 minus the current total modulo 10) modulo 10 single-coupon promotions are created through the admin REST sequence the sales-rep GraphQL suite uses to create an in-case coupon (no cap, name prefix AGENT-TEST-SRCPN-CLAMP). {HYPOTHESIS} The page clamps a local page ref in a watch on the page count; the refetch that delivers the smaller total is triggered by paging, not by time. [AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT] obtain an admin token; read the current salesRepCoupons totalCount as the rep (TOTAL_0); create D disposable single-coupon promotions so that TOTAL_0 + D leaves 1 on the last page of ten; poll the rep list until totalCount = TOTAL_0 + D (TOTAL_1) for at most 60 s

[ACT] click the last page in the pager
[WAIT] the page settles
[KEY] record the pager state (PAGES_AFTER), the page the rep is on and the number of cards on screen (CARDS_AFTER)

Title: Coupons — the loading skeleton and the load-failed state are shown and announced
Section: Sales Rep Hub > Customer profile > Available coupons
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]
MANUAL (EX-200), decided 2026-11-03 after REG-2026-11-03-1732 left it BLOCKED: both states need network control a real-user lane does not have. The loading skeleton is on screen only while the salesRepCoupons response is in flight, too short for a snapshot to catch unless the response is slowed by about 3 s; the load-failed state needs that one request to fail while the rest of the page works. The Playwright lanes offer neither throttling nor request interception (browser_evaluate / browser_run_code_unsafe are refused for it), Chrome DevTools can do both but cannot authenticate, and on a store that lists coupons no data state makes the request slow or fail. A person runs it in a browser's DevTools: sign in as SR_REP_PRIMARY, Network panel, throttle the tab (a custom profile with ~3 s latency) for the skeleton, then Block request URL on the salesRepCoupons operation of /graphql/sales-rep for the failed state.
The sales-rep plugin and the Marketing module are installed, so the 'Available coupons' block is registered and the coupons route exists. The empty state ('No coupons available') cannot be reached on a store that lists coupons; it is covered by the plugin's component tests, not by this case. Failure is forced by blocking the salesRepCoupons request in DevTools. The widget on the profile and the page share one list component, so both are walked.
Steps:
[SETUP] throttle the network of the tab so that the salesRepCoupons response arrives about 3 s late
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/my-customers/@td(ORG_TECHFLOW.platform_id)/coupons
[KEY] while loading, record the number of placeholder cards (SKELETON_N), whether the live region of the page reads anything (STATUS_LOADING) and whether the placeholders are hidden from the accessibility tree (SKELETON_HIDDEN)
[WAIT] the coupon cards have rendered
[SETUP] remove the throttle and force every salesRepCoupons request of the tab to fail (network interception)
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/my-customers/@td(ORG_TECHFLOW.platform_id)/coupons
[WAIT] the page settles
[KEY] record the text on screen in place of the cards (FAILED_TEXT), whether any coupon card is still on screen (CARDS_AFTER_FAIL) and the text of the live region (STATUS_FAILED)
[ACT] click '2' in the pager if a pager is shown
[WAIT] the page settles
[KEY] record again whether any coupon card from the earlier successful load is on screen (STALE_CARDS)
Cross_Layer_Checks: [CONSOLE] the forced failure is logged once, no unhandled rejection
Failure_Signals:
previous rows stay on screen after a failed refetch
the failure has no text or the live region stays empty
the placeholders are announced as content or their count differs from the page size
Cleanup:
[SETUP] remove the network interception and the throttle
none persisted

Title: Coupons — the Expires date a rep reads is never after the last day the code works
Section: Sales Rep Hub > Customer profile > Available coupons
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]
The sales-rep plugin and the Marketing module are installed, so the 'Available coupons' block is registered and the coupons route exists. Needs a coupon whose end, in the BROWSER's zone, is exactly 00:00:00 -- the instant at which the date shown and the last working day come apart. Record BROWSER_OFFSET_H from the lane first (new Date().getTimezoneOffset()/-60); the case needs a zone other than UTC. Discover the coupon from the rep API (a listed item whose endDate falls on a whole local midnight, for example a code ending at 22:00Z in a UTC+2 browser); if none exists record BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET naming the zone. EXPECTATION KEPT AS SPEC EVEN THOUGH THE BUILD VIOLATES IT: the date a rep reads under 'Expires' is never after the last day on which the code works (observed 2026-11-03: ZUR10 ends 2027-05-31T22:00Z and a UTC+1 browser shows Jun 1, 2027, a day on which the code never works). PO-QUESTION: which calendar date is 'Expires': UTC, the store's zone or the viewer's? The relation below holds for any of them as long as the shown day is not later than the last working one in the viewer's zone. This row therefore stays Draft until the build or the oracle changes.
